# Step - in_e

`in_e` · `inE` · category: [Walking the graph](../../traversal/step_reference.md#walking-the-graph)

Moves to the incoming edges, optionally only edges with the given labels.

## Forms

```text
in_e()
in_e(arg1: any)
in_e(arg1: array)
in_e(arg1: any, arg2: any)
in_e(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(3).in_e("created").count().next()   // 3
```
